text:
maria: seeing a spike of 504s for tenant-458 during onboarding burst ~10:15 UTC, support hit by multiple customer timeouts. repeating every ~30s.
alex: confirmed from logs: gateway return 504 downstream after 15s. stack shows waiting on model pod readiness.
jess: is this the same tenant that hit burst yesterday? they ramp from 0 -> 80 qps.
ryan: looks like HPA/KEDA didn't scale fast enough. ScaledObject pollInterval is 30s + cooldown 120s. that combined with cold-start is killing latency.
maria: customer reported Auth/Billing checks passed (200) then generation request 504. they pasted request id: req_7f9d3.
oncall-sre: @ryan can you paste relevant logs?
ryan: from pod-provisioner logs: 
```
I0317 10:15:12 scale-controller.go:231] Received metric spike for tenant-458: queue_length=72
I0317 10:15:12 keda scaler: scale requested for scaledobject/tenant-458-gen
I0317 10:15:42 scaler: pollInterval elapsed, scaling action delayed
I0317 10:16:12 probe: pod not Ready due to model init (loading weights) ~ 38s
I0317 10:16:35 gateway: request timed out waiting for backend (15s)
```
jess: the config uses prewarm=false for this tenant (legacy onboarding). that explains cold start.
alex: could we fast-fix by temporary prewarm or reducing pollInterval?
oncall-sre: we can push a quick change: set ScaledObject.pollInterval=10s and cooldown=30s for tenant-458. also enable one prewarmed replica.
maria: patch would those require deploy? how fast?
ryan: it's a config change on keda scaler config; apply should be immediate for new events. but existing cold pods still need model init ~40s.
jess: customer saw ~3 consecutive 504s; each happened during the same ramp window.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline: PR #4329 opened to set pollInterval=10 and initialReplicas=1 for tenant-458 scaledobject.
alex: also adding short-term mitigation: gateway retry 1 with 1s backoff for 502/504 to avoid surfacing immediate errors to customers. low risk.
oncall-sre: agree. I'll coordinate rollout: 1) apply keda config change, 2) enable initialReplica prewarm, 3) add retry.
maria: support notified customer about mitigation and ETA ~ 12m.
ryan: follow-up action: audit all tenants with onboarding-flag and prewarm=false; add guardrail that auto-enables initialReplicas>=1 for >50 qps ramp.
jess: logging note: add scatter of model-init-timings to trace to identify heavy models.
oncall-sre: marking incident for postmortem. tagging owners: @ryan, @jess, @alex.
maria: closing here once PR merges and 504s subside, will update ticket. :white_check_mark:
